metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Blue Box
metas.description: Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Gassal
metas.description: A Turkish mortician in his 30s, Baki is an introverted man content with his isolation from society. However, when he comes up against death at close range, a troubling question strikes him: who would wash his body after he dies? This realization pushes him to venture out into the world, hoping to connect with people and perhaps even find a spouse. Yet, his life-changing decision proves difficult to go through with, leading to a series of awkwardly humorous and sometimes bizarre situations.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · The On1y One
metas.description: When their parents marry, two high school students become stepbrothers and navigate their relationship, turning from enemies into something more special.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Study Group
metas.description: A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · 90's - A Middle Class Biopic
metas.description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Last One Laughing: UK
metas.description: Ten top UK comedians face off in Jimmy Carr's challenge: make others laugh while keeping a straight face. They'll try everything to crack their opponents, but must never break themselves.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Conan O'Brien Must Go
metas.description: After years of conversations with listeners from across the world on his podcast Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend (2018), Conan O'Brien sets off on an epic journey to connect with some of his dedicated followers in person.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2024 · India's Got Latent
metas.description: Samay Raina and the guest judges hilariously critique the untapped, undeniably entertaining "latent" talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Riot Women
metas.description: Follows a group of middle-aged women, as they form a punk-rock band to participate in a talent contest.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Resident Playbook
metas.description: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · Family Kirana Store
metas.description: A middle-class small-town family's father obsesses over his struggling grocery store attached to their home. He fights to attract customers while facing robberies, counterfeit money, and other threats.
